content.text: {"extract":[{"requirement_id":"R1","evidence":"Draft monthly Town Newsletter articles and maintain a monthly STEP-UP blog for The Patch."},{"requirement_id":"R2","evidence":"Develop press releases with program leaders and act as the primary media liaison."},{"requirement_id":"R3","evidence":"Prepare a graphic-designer solicitation for consistent branding across communications collateral and the website."},{"requirement_id":"R4","evidence":"Coordinate branded flyers, fact sheets, program tools, and survey summaries with the designer and program leaders, verifying permission to use partner logos."},{"requirement_id":"R5","evidence":"Edit communications, including website materials, for consistent style and grammatical correctness."},{"requirement_id":"R6","evidence":"Oversee website editorial content and regular updates with the website consultant; research and periodically check partner links, and define specifications for additional website features."},{"requirement_id":"R7","evidence":"Maintain a willing-participant interview list, develop and conduct interviews using audio/video where appropriate, arrange technical help when directed, and archive responses with permission waivers under Town guidelines."},{"requirement_id":"R8","evidence":"Create participant vignettes, summaries, and case studies from authorized interview and audiovisual material."},{"requirement_id":"R9","evidence":"Support community-wide and targeted events with marketing materials and outreach to participants and attendees."},{"requirement_id":"R10","evidence":"Research and archive STEP-UP media, and gather materials and best practices from other Better Buildings Neighborhood grantees for the program toolkit."},{"requirement_id":"R11","evidence":"Develop a repository of STEP-UP photographs and videos."},{"requirement_id":"R12","evidence":"Research relevant awards and funding-recognition opportunities for the Town."}]}
